t.t: Keep access organised across your buildings.
Residents change. Staff need different doors. Contractors arrive for a limited job. SmartphoneKey gives property teams a structured place to manage those changes.

div.p: Put the person in the correct site, issue the credentials they need and revoke access when their permission ends. Check device status for changes that are waiting to be delivered.
Let the appropriate local administrator handle the site while maintaining a consistent operating process across the portfolio.
Manage supported guest or temporary credentials for the required doors. Review the outcome and close the access lifecycle after the visit.
Add supported cameras and device workflows where they solve a real operational need. Check model compatibility and service scope before deployment.
Bring these details to the setup guide or to a conversation with our team:

t.t: See a planning starting point without sharing contact details, or talk to us about your buildings.
Build the installation. Keep the customer relationship.
Use SmartphoneKey to organise customer sites and support the access system after installation. Combine the right reader configuration with clear handover and management workflows.

li.p: Check door hardware, power, network conditions, credential requirements and supported devices.
Follow the model-specific installation guidance. Choose LTE or Wi-Fi according to coverage and the site's network requirements.
Organise the site, configure supported access and assign the appropriate local management responsibilities.
Find the customer's site, review its devices and use activity and operation status to investigate issues.

div.p: LTE and Wi-Fi readers share the same platform. The connection the site can support decides which one fits; power and compatible door hardware are needed either way. Every reader can also act as a Thread Border Router and as a router in the Thread mesh, with the same firmware.
div.a: LTE or Wi-Fi: what fits your site?

div.p: Discuss distribution, integration, service and branding requirements with our team. The available scope depends on the agreed offering.

t.t: Read the installation guidance and compare readers on your own, or start a partnership conversation.
